channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump is pushing a massive AI buildout. His own voters are wary of what comes with it
item.description: A new CNBC survey finds broad voter opposition to nearby AI data centers, creating a political challenge for Trump and Republicans ahead of the midterm election.

item.title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
item.description: As Nvidia has gone from chipmaker to industry financier, some investors see the company taking on outsized risk tied to the AI buildout.

item.title: Why popular airplanes are getting scrapped years early
item.description: Airplanes are getting dismantled for parts years ahead of schedule because engines and other components are in short supply.

item.title: What next for France as riots rattle markets? Three questions facing investors ahead of more protests
item.description: French unrest pushed bond yields to a 24-year high as investors weigh budget, growth and sectors risks ahead of more protests.

item.title: Berkshire shares shake the Buffett blues with new all-time highs
item.description: After almost 18 months, Berkshire Hathaway shares have entirely erased all the ground they lost in the wake of Warren Buffett's surprise announcement at the 2025 shareholders meeting that he would step down as CEO.

item.title: Goldman says these top tech stocks have plenty of upside ahead of earnings
item.description: Goldman Sachs said this week there are plenty of top tech companies to buy heading into their quarterly results.

item.title: Ukraine says Starlink and Starshield high speed restrictions have been lifted
item.description: Ukraine says restrictions on Starlink and Starshield have been lifted, restoring connectivity to fast-moving military systems after disruptions.

item.title: AI's 'Black October': Critical PHP flaws set off global security scramble
item.description: Governments and businesses around the globe are scrambling to contain the fallout after the PHP vulnerabilities leaked online.

item.title: Trump dropping some Canada tariffs but 'replacing' them with other products
item.description: Sen. Susan Collins announced Canada was dropping Canadian tariffs, but the White House later said it was "replacing" the ones removed from the list.

item.title: Moody's holds steady on France's credit rating as country grapples with turmoil and higher yields
item.description: Moody's left its credit rating on France at Aa3, giving the country some relief in a week of unrest.

item.title: Scalpers offer Apple iPhone Duo buyers hundreds extra outside Beijing launch
item.description: Apple's global launch of the foldable iPhone Duo brought scalpers to the Beijing flagship store looking to pay big for the already pricey devices.

item.title: Trump's executive order targets mortgage insurance, refinance costs. What it means for borrowers
item.description: Trump's executive order on housing aims to lower mortgage costs. Here's what it means for homeowners and buyers.

item.title: Turmoil hits AI buildout as neoclouds face pressure, credit risks mount and Solidigm pulls IPO
item.description: Stock slumps, pulled IPOs and rising spreads on credit default swaps this week sets stage for hyperscaler earnings.

item.title: What a day in customer service looks like — as AI changes everything
item.description: Customer service can be a "really, really difficult job." Will AI make it easier — or cause even more headaches?

item.title: Apple is set to take back the market-cap crown from Nvidia. Upcoming earnings may push it over the top
item.description: Apple stock is trading near record highs and closing in on Nvidia's market cap. Portfolio manager Jeff Kilburg explains what's driving the rally and why he thinks the momentum could continue.

item.title: Dow tumbles more than 600 points as oil prices rise and market sell-off hits most sectors
item.description: The Dow Industrials fell on Friday as Middle East tensions rose.

item.title: Fire devastates the Eagle's Nest retreat built for Hitler in Germany. A person is detained
item.description: The local tourism authority said it wasn't clear whether authorities could salvage parts of the building. Police later said it burned down almost completely.

item.title: Trump says he ordered DOJ suit to block Alaska Senate race certification if Republican loses
item.description: There are two Dan Sullivans on the ballot in the Senate race in Alaska. The DOJ says that fact could help Democratic nominee Mary Peltola defeat both of them.

item.title: In hunt for Starlink alternative, Ukraine partners with Nokia and satellite maker ICEYE
item.description: With SpaceX imposing speed limits on Starlink in Ukraine and hampering military operations, Kyiv is looking for alternatives.

item.title: Musk's SpaceX is still restricting Starlink in Ukraine and the toll is rising
item.description: Since last week, Ukraine has reported restrictions on Starshield, a version of SpaceX's Starlink, hampering its military operations against Russia.

item.title: CrowdStrike CEO's alarming prediction — plus, the sell-off spreads beyond tech
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Now is your last chance to qualify for a Southwest Companion Pass with a credit card bonus
item.description: Southwest is rolling out major changes to how you can earn elite status and its Companion Pass. Apply for a Southwest credit card by Dec. 2, 2026, to help earn the pass.

item.title: TikTok U.S. hunts for multiple gigawatts of computing capacity, sources tell CNBC
item.description: The operator of the social media platform in the U.S. has sounded out opportunities to obtain capacity over the coming years.

item.title: Meta shares are down 9% this week. Here's why Mike Khouw is buying now
item.description: Meta shares just had their worst week in four years. Here's why Mike Khouw is buying now

item.title: Qatar deal to buy U.S. natural gas shows how Iran war has redrawn global energy markets
item.description: The Iran war is transforming global energy markets and benefiting U.S. companies, especially liquefied natural gas exporters.

item.title: Democratic socialist set to become D.C. mayor — and face Trump's pushback
item.description: Following Zohran Mamdani's election as New York City mayor, another democratic socialist is set to become mayor of Washington, D.C.

item.title: France is flashing euro crisis signals. This time, the fault lines are different
item.description: French borrowing costs have surged as debt and political risks mount, raising questions over whether the stress could spread across the euro zone.

item.title: Investors are starting to find opportunities in the battered bond market
item.description: Some market participants see reason for hope in a market bludgeoned this year.

item.title: U.S. fines Air France, KLM over flights in prohibited Iraqi airspace
item.description: The Transportation Department said it was fining Air France and KLM $425,000 for operating flights in prohibited Iraqi airspace while code-sharing with Delta.

item.title: American Express is cutting 5% of its workforce to 'prepare for AI'
item.description: Amex, which reported third-quarter results earlier Friday, is taking a $336 million restructuring charge in the quarter, CEO Stephen Squeri said Friday.
